assets.title: Copper Orchard
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original collectible full-picture reward background for a modern Ukrainian-themed Xonix arcade game. Landscape 4:3 aspect ratio, preferably 1536x1152. Beautiful professional modern pixel art with 80s/90s adventure-game nostalgia: carefully hand-placed pixel clusters, crisp edges on a consistent visible pixel grid, rich limited colors, selective dithering, layered atmospheric depth, sophisticated composition, memorable light. Full-bleed finished illustration, no framing, no UI, no grid overlay, no text, no logos, no actors, no drones, no weapons or enemies baked into the image; those are interactive game layers. Original imaginary places inspired by Ukraine, not documentary depictions or copies of existing games. Center subject readable when scaled down and rewarding small details near edges. No photorealism, no blur, no smooth vector gradients.
Scene: A small Ukrainian village and orchard at radiant dawn. Foreground sunflower leaves and copper autumn apple trees frame a winding lane, whitewashed houses with cobalt window frames and warm terracotta roofs, beyond them golden fields and a luminous pale blue river. Quiet signs of return and resilience, a little garden and restored fence. A tiny abstract blue-and-yellow pennant on a distant rooftop. Sunrise is the central focus, cinematic atmospheric depth.
